purpose: Track 130 first-hand, fast-moving sources across frontier AI, production deployment, aerospace, quantum computing and technology business without confusing social reach with technical proof.

selection_policy.objective: 最獨家、最快速、最接近原始決策或實作的人與團隊優先。
must_have: 本人、官方團隊、實驗室、任務營運方或具名一手記者
能提供 launch、paper、model、code、mission、funding 或 strategy 的時間優勢
可用 canonical X handle 與至少一個耐久一手來源交叉確認
AI 部署人物優先選內部工程師、CTO、技術創辦人與維護核心 runtime／eval／data path 的 builder
downrank: 主要內容為轉貼、剪輯、匿名爆料或無原始連結
只靠粉絲數、藍勾或單篇爆文
廣告密度高但缺少可驗證方法、數據或決策
selection_policy.ranking: P0 official launch/lab/mission first, then P1 first-hand builder/researcher/operator, then named beat reporter with primary links.
selection_policy.claim_boundary: 速度決定何時看；source authority、原始碼、paper、官方文件與可重現實驗才決定是否相信或採用。

x.boundary: Codex in-app browser readback observed Home, Following and public timeline. Session access is transient and does not authorize follow, like, repost, reply, posting, cookie export or private-session scraping.

reddit.boundary: No account required. Public feeds may rate-limit and must fail closed. Reddit is discovery-only and claims must be traced upstream.

github.boundary: Repository, release, issue and commit metadata plus pinned source review; popularity does not prove correctness or deployment.

blogs.boundary: Prefer author or organization originals and preserve published/updated dates.

intake_candidates.name: Agent-Reach
intake_candidates.auth: mixed; some channels require local session or backend
intake_candidates.strength: capability doctor, backend routing and broad platform reach
intake_candidates.risk: login backends and platform-specific failure modes need per-channel review

intake_candidates.name: last30days
intake_candidates.auth: zero-config subset plus optional keys and browser sessions
intake_candidates.strength: cross-source scoring, date window, health doctor and grounded brief
intake_candidates.risk: cookie/session extraction and many third-party backends enlarge the trust surface

intake_candidates.name: RSSHub
intake_candidates.auth: public routes by default; some routes require credentials
intake_candidates.strength: durable pull model, caching and incremental feeds
intake_candidates.risk: route breakage, AGPL obligations and per-route platform policy

intake_candidates.name: SurfSense
intake_candidates.strength: typed posts/comments/transcripts plus searchable knowledge base
intake_candidates.risk: large operational footprint and connector claims still need independent canaries

intake_candidates.name: Firecrawl MCP
intake_candidates.auth: keyless rate-limited search/scrape or API key/OAuth
intake_candidates.strength: read-only search profile, clean extraction and retries
intake_candidates.risk: not a social graph or logged-session solution

intake_candidates.name: Exa MCP
intake_candidates.strength: advanced domain/date/category search and clean content
intake_candidates.risk: index coverage is not platform-native comments or timeline readback

intake_candidates.name: Bright Data MCP
intake_candidates.auth: paid API token; advanced tools require credits
intake_candidates.strength: structured web-data APIs and anti-block infrastructure
intake_candidates.risk: cost, external data processor, policy/compliance and broad browser authority

intake_candidates.name: Apify MCP
intake_candidates.auth: OAuth or API token; per-actor pricing
intake_candidates.strength: very broad actor catalog and dynamic tool discovery
intake_candidates.risk: actor schema, maintenance, pricing and compliance vary by actor

intake_candidates.name: Tavily MCP
intake_candidates.risk: overlaps Exa/Firecrawl and lacks platform-native social depth

intake_candidates.name: YouTube Transcript MCP
intake_candidates.auth: no key for transcript; optional video-analysis key
intake_candidates.strength: timestamps, chapters, language fallback and narrow read-only scope
intake_candidates.risk: captions can be unavailable or inaccurate; video visuals need a separate oracle

intake_candidates.name: Reddit MCP
intake_candidates.risk: also exposes content creation; require a read-only fork/profile and rate-limit tests

intake_candidates.name: Zero-config Reddit MCP
intake_candidates.risk: scraping and user-activity features create rate-limit, privacy and breakage risk

intake_candidates.name: X API v2 MCP
intake_candidates.auth: X developer credentials and OAuth tokens
intake_candidates.strength: official API v2, typed search/timeline and rate-limit handling
intake_candidates.risk: small project, broad write tools, developer access and platform cost

intake_candidates.name: Bluesky Social MCP
intake_candidates.auth: AT Protocol account for write paths
intake_candidates.strength: open protocol and direct social data
intake_candidates.risk: small project and unnecessary write surface; direct public AT API may be simpler

intake_candidates.name: Mastodon MCP
intake_candidates.risk: small project and instance variability; direct REST/RSS may be simpler

deployment_brief_contract.title: AI Deployment Field Brief
deployment_brief_contract.editorial_rule: 沒有新的 first-hand artifact 或 implementation delta 就不發快報；禁止把人物聲量、轉貼或產品文案寫成技術進展。

horizons.title: Deployment Flash
horizons.decision: 今天哪個 production 變化值得五分鐘注意？

horizons.title: Method Memo
horizons.decision: 哪個方法跨兩個以上來源重現，值得做 canary？
horizons.output: 一篇觀點文：共識、衝突、implementation anatomy、反證、public canary

horizons.title: Stack Thesis
horizons.decision: eval／runtime／retrieval／observability 堆疊的重心是否移動？
horizons.output: 技術地圖：promote、watch、demote、missing interface 與對 IC automation 的轉譯

story_anatomy: Delta：相較前一版、前一日或既有方法，實際改了甚麼
Owner translation：如何降低 ASIC 前端設計／驗證認知負載或縮短可信迭代
Falsifier：下一個甚麼證據會推翻、降級或阻止採用
priority_gate: FIRST_HAND：本人、公司工程頁、原始碼、paper 或 release
IMPLEMENTATION_DENSE：至少揭露一個介面、資料流、failure mode、量測或可重現方法
OWNER_RELEVANT：可轉譯成 evidence、verification、debug replay、runtime governance 或 cognitive-load reduction
NOVEL_DELTA：相較歷史紀錄有可說明的新增；只有重述則不入選
deployment_brief_contract.history_contract: append-only by observed_at and canonical URL; corrections supersede but never erase the earlier interpretation

claim_boundary: A 130-account watchlist is a research intake set, not endorsement and not proof that the accounts were followed in X. Public profile mirrors are discovery-only; important technical claims must be traced to code, paper, official documentation, release artifacts or reproducible experiment.
